x_query.oql:
get works where published since 2026-09-25
  and title-abstract has (soil AND (stemmed "salt marsh" OR coastal OR dune OR saline) AND (metagenome OR metagenomic OR metagenomics))
  and published through 2026-10-11
  and type is ([article](article) or [preprint](preprint) or [review](review))
x_query.x_new_oql: get works from 2026-09-25 through 2026-10-11 with (soil AND (stemmed "salt marsh" OR coastal OR dune OR saline) AND (metagenome OR metagenomic OR metagenomics)) in the title or abstract where type is ([article](article) or [preprint](preprint) or [review](review))
